name: indickit
description: Small, exact utilities for text in Indian languages: a phonetic key that matches a name across 21 Indian scripts and English, and a normalizer that gives text that looks the same one encoding.

scripts.build: bun build js/phonetic.ts --outfile dist/phonetic.js --target browser --format esm && bun build js/normalize.ts --outfile dist/normalize.js --target browser --format esm && bun build js/segment.ts --outfile dist/segment.js --target browser --format esm && tsc -p tsconfig.json
